title: chat get/find_direct_by_contact_id: extra round-trip for unread_count
description: In chat.rs, ChatStore::get() (line 169) and find_direct_by_contact_id() (line 134) each call self.unread_count(&id) as a separate SQL round-trip after fetching the chat row. ChatStore::list() (line 186-193) inlines the identical logic as a correlated subquery in a single statement. This inconsistency means get() and find_direct_by_contact_id() pay two sequential statement round-trips where one would suffice, and in a hypothetical future multi-statement transaction context the two reads are not atomic (the unread count could change between the chat row fetch and the unread_count query). Aligning get() and find_direct_by_contact_id() to use the same inline subquery as list() eliminates the extra round-trip and makes the read atomic.
